title: A land stopped at rebase prints its resume remedy before the git worktree add that makes it work
goal: When land stops at rebase after removing the worker's worktree, the remedy it prints works when run as printed: the git worktree add line comes first, or the remedy says to run it first. Found by the SP-basca7ae review (S2 on ST-2pberuyb).

run:
SCEN="wt"
import os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd(); scen = SCEN
T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="plant-"))
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in ("CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID","KB_COORD_URL")}
env.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T,"coord.sqlite"), CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=os.path.join(T,"cfg"), COLUMNS="200")
def sh(*a, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
O=os.path.join(T,"origin.git"); K=os.path.join(T,"clone")
sh("git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",O); sh("git","clone","-q",O,K)
for k,v in (("user.email","a@example.com"),("user.name","n")): sh("git","config",k,v,cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R,"backlog.json"),K)
for d in ("kb/_self/backlog","_tools","kb/_self/reports"): os.makedirs(os.path.join(K,d))
def w(p,t): 
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(K,p)),exist_ok=True); open(os.path.join(K,p),"w").write(t)
for p in ("kb/_self/tools.md","kb/_self/other.md","_tools/a.py","_tools/old.py","_tools/gone.py"): w(p,"planted %s\n"%p*5)
w("_tools/bin.dat","\x00\x01base\n")
sh("git","add",".",cwd=K); sh("git","commit","-q","-m","base",cwd=K); sh("git","push","-q","origin","HEAD:main",cwd=K); sh("git","fetch","-q",cwd=K)
def bl(*a): return sh(sys.executable,os.path.join(R,"_tools","backlog.py"),"--root",K,*a,cwd=K)
def nid(r):
    m=re.search(r"\b(?:ST|SP)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b",r.stdout); 
    if not m: print("noid",r.stdout,r.stderr); sys.exit(2)
    return m.group(0)
SP=nid(bl("new","sprint","--title","S","--goal","g"))
touches=["kb/_self/tools.md","kb/_self/other.md","_tools/a.py","_tools/old.py","_tools/gone.py","_tools/bin.dat","_tools/new.py"]
def story(t): 
    a=["new","story","--title",t,"--goal","g","--sprint",SP]
    for x in touches: a+=["--touch",x]
    return nid(bl(*a))
Y=story("y"); X=story("x"); Z=story("z")
sh("git","add",".",cwd=K); sh("git","commit","-q","-m","plan",cwd=K); sh("git","push","-q","origin","HEAD:main",cwd=K)
sh("git","checkout","-q","-b","work/"+Y,cwd=K)
def commit(msg): sh("git","add","-A",cwd=K); print(sh("git","commit","-q","-m",msg,cwd=K).stderr)
w("kb/_self/tools.md","line from y\n"); w("_tools/a.py","y\n"); w("_tools/bin.dat","\x00\x01y\n"); w("_tools/gone.py","y edit\n"); w("_tools/old.py","y edit\n")
w("_tools/new.py","y new\n")
commit("y work\n\nKB-Work: "+Y)
sh("git","checkout","-q","main",cwd=K)
w("kb/_self/tools.md","line from x\n"); 
commit("x work\n\nKB-Work: "+X)
w("kb/_self/tools.md","line from z\n"); w("_tools/bin.dat","\x00\x01z\n")
commit("z work\n\nKB-Work: %s\nKB-Work: %s"%(Z,X))
w("kb/_self/tools.md","line from nobody\n")
commit("chore: no trailer")   # latest change, no KB-Work
w("_tools/a.py","x\n"); commit("a by x\n\nKB-Work: "+X)
sh("git","rm","-q","_tools/gone.py",cwd=K); commit("rm gone\n\nKB-Work: "+Z)
sh("git","mv","_tools/old.py","_tools/renamed.py",cwd=K); commit("rename\n\nKB-Work: "+X)
w("_tools/new.py","x new\n"); commit("new by z\n\nKB-Work: "+Z)
sh("git","push","-q","origin","HEAD:main",cwd=K)
if scen=="wt":
    wtp=os.path.join(K,".claude","worktrees","agent-"+Y)
    print(sh("git","worktree","add",wtp,"work/"+Y,cwd=K).stderr)
r=bl("land",Y); print("EXIT",r.returncode); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
print(sh("git","status","--porcelain",cwd=K).stdout, "T=",T, "Y=",Y)

m=re.search(r"backlog\.py[^\n]*dispatch --resume[^\n]*",r.stdout+r.stderr)
wt=os.path.join(K,".claude","worktrees","agent-"+Y)
ok=bool(m) and (os.path.isdir(wt) or (r.stdout+r.stderr).find("git worktree add")<(r.stdout+r.stderr).find("dispatch --resume"))
print("worktree back before the remedy:",ok);shutil.rmtree(T,ignore_errors=True);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: How does the rebase stop make its remedy work as printed once land removed the worker's worktree?
options: Print the git worktree add line before the remedy line
Keep the order and reword the remedy to say run the git worktree add first
gates.recommendation: Print the git worktree add line before the remedy line
gates.reason: the commands then run top to bottom as printed
